definition: Contract under GDPR Art. 28 when a service provider processes personal data on your behalf, for example an AI vendor for your company.
Data under GDPR Art. 9, such as health, religious beliefs or trade union membership. Processing is allowed only under narrow conditions.
Under the EU AI Act, whoever uses an AI system under their own authority in a professional context. A company using an AI assistant is usually a deployer.
Grading information by protection need; in the example model public, internal, confidential and specially protected. Your organization sets the levels.
GDPR principle (Art. 5(1)(c)): process only as much personal data as the purpose needs.
Your organization's decision that a specific combination of tool, configuration, purpose and data class may be used.
A convincingly worded but false or unsupported output of an AI model, such as an invented figure, source or responsibility.

Under Art. 4 of the EU AI Act, applicable since 2 February 2025: providers and deployers take measures that support their staff's AI literacy, matched to context and prior knowledge. No format or certificate is prescribed.
A language model trained on large amounts of text to produce likely continuations. It delivers wording, not checked facts.
A marker such as [date] for a missing detail. Required in the brief, it makes gaps visible instead of filling them with invented details.
The document or system that records a fact, such as decision minutes, a contract or the accounts. A second model is not a primary source.
An instruction to an AI model. Context, task, format and limits make the result checkable.
How thoroughly an AI output is checked. It follows the impact of an error, reversibility and audience.
Replacing identifying details with codes while the mapping is kept separately (GDPR Art. 4(5)). Pseudonymised data stays personal data.
AI use for work outside approved tools and controls, such as private chat accounts, browser extensions or new features in bought software.
A second, responsible person reviews and signs off before a consequential result is used.
